summary_by_use.label: Policy training
summary_by_use.illus_result: RoboTwin mean success rises from 83.8 to 91.8% with video co-training.

summary_by_use.label: Action generation
summary_by_use.illus_result: Fraction of target length processed with future vision: wiping 0.66 → 0.70, peeling 0.40 → 0.38. The source labels these completion measures as success rates.

summary_by_use.label: Planning and selection
summary_by_use.illus_result: With eight candidates per decision, RoboCasa success is 77.4% with consensus scoring and 82.5% with geometric scoring. The single-candidate policy reaches 80.8% under a different search budget.

summary_by_use.label: Predictive representation
summary_by_use.illus_result: More training noise worsens clean one-step fit; intermediate noise gives the best recursive Goop rollout.

summary_by_use.label: Assessment
summary_by_use.illus_result: Mean evaluator correlation is 0.844 for WM-Mix and 0.646 for WM-Robot.

summary_by_use.label: Execution and intervention
summary_by_use.illus_result: Physical success rises from 47 to 64% when the corrector can read cached tactile predictions.
